name: post-training-benchmarks-viewer
description: A dataset and viewer for inspecting post-training benchmark results across models and tasks; it aggregates model evaluation metrics (e.g., accuracy, latency, throughput) to make post-training comparisons and visualizations easier. The resource is intended to help researchers and engineers explore performance trade-offs after model training and during deployment tuning.
evaluation_method: various (accuracy, latency, throughput depending on the benchmark)
reputation: Provided by Hugging Face as a tooling/dataset resource for inspecting benchmark results; useful to users evaluating model performance but not a mainstream standardized benchmark.
